_doc: Channel playlists (user's decision 2026-11-23). `python tools/yt_upload.py playlists` creates missing ones (public) and adds missing videos in this order; `yt_upload.py <slug>` adds a new upload to every playlist that lists its slug. Entries are slugs; `video_ids` maps a slug to its YouTube id.

playlists.title: Why Almost Nobody Lives Here
playlists.description: Empty places on the map and the reasons behind them: climate, rock, water, history and money. Satellite images, maps and sourced numbers.

playlists.title: Sinking Cities and Vanishing Coasts
playlists.description: Places the sea is taking back, and what people build to stop it.

playlists.title: Seas, Lakes and Deserts That Changed
playlists.description: Seas that dried up, deserts that were green, lakes that are shrinking: how the map changes.

playlists.title: Rivers, Dams and Megaprojects
playlists.description: Who controls the water, and the giant projects built on land, rivers and oil.
